title: Input bits with zero padding
statement: For $n\in\mathbb{N}$, a Boolean vector $x\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and $o,j\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be listed in index order and extended by false values beyond its end. The value at position $o+j$ in this extended list is the bit $x_{o+j}$ when $o+j<n$, and false otherwise.
